description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Ford Pro is seeking an early- to mid-career Full Stack Software Engineer to build services, APIs, frontend applications, and cloud deployments for connected vehicle data. The role involves developing backend and frontend solutions, integrating streaming data, supporting production systems, contributing to AI-enabled tools, and collaborating with engineering and product teams.
Full-stack engineer building vehicle-data APIs, web dashboards, streaming integrations, and cloud-deployed AI features

Responsibilities:
• Backend services and APIs. Build and maintain REST APIs and microservices in Java and Spring Boot, backed by SQL databases and BigQuery
• Frontend apps and dashboards. Build features and reusable components in React or Angular with TypeScript that help people explore vehicle data
• Streaming integrations. Write Kafka and Pub/Sub producers and consumers, and learn how to handle retries, failed messages, and message order
• Cloud deployments. Package apps with Docker and deploy them to OpenShift and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE), including configuration, secrets, and health checks
• Testing and quality. Write unit and integration tests with JUnit and frontend test tools (for example, Jest or Cypress), take part in code reviews and pairing, and learn test-driven development
• Monitoring and support. Add logging, alerts, and dashboards in Cloud Logging and Cloud Monitoring, and help troubleshoot production issues using runbooks
• Good engineering habits. Use Git and CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Tekton), keep dependencies up to date, fix issues found by code quality and security scans, and follow secure coding, API security, and data privacy practices
• AI in practice. Use tools like GitHub Copilot every day for code, tests, and documentation. You'll also help with the team's AI work, for example: building the API and UI for an assistant that answers plain-English questions about vehicle data; calling LLM APIs to draft metadata, summaries, or release notes; trying simple ways for an AI assistant to answer questions from team documentation; writing test cases that check AI output is accurate and safe
• Working as a team. Work with senior engineers, the team's technical lead (Anchor), product owners, data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them. data engineers, and platform teams to plan work in small pieces and ship them

Requirements:
• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
• 1 to 4 years of professional software engineering experience. Strong internships or co-ops count
• Hands-on experience building backend services or REST APIs in Java with Spring Boot
• Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases
• Day-to-day use of Git, and experience writing automated tests (for example, JUnit)
• A basic understanding of Docker and deploying applications to a cloud or container platform
• The habit of asking "how will I know this works?" and testing before you ship
• Visa sponsorship is not available for this position
• Candidates for positions with Ford Motor Company must be legally authorized to work in the United States

Preferred:
• GCP experience, especially Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud SQL, or Cloud Storage
• Kafka or Pub/Sub, or concepts such as retries, dead-letter queues, and message ordering
• OpenShift or Kubernetes (deployments, config maps, secrets, health checks)
• CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Tekton, or Jenkins, code scanning tools such as SonarQube, Checkmarx, or FOSSA, and some Terraform
• Monitoring with Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace, Grafana, or Splunk, and setting reliability targets (SLOs)
• Agile practices such as Scrum, XP, test-driven development, or pair programming
• Hands-on work with AI, such as calling an LLM API, building a small RAG app, or an agent. School, hackathon, and personal projects all count
• Python for scripting or data work
• Experience with IoT, telemetry, or other time-series data
